test_name: Verify Adding an Accessory to Cart
description: This test ensures that users can add an accessory product to their shopping cart.
steps: Navigate to the Accessories category page.
Scroll through the list of products.
Click on a product to view its details.
Verify that the product is added to the cart.
Verify that the product appears in the cart.
Check the product quantity and price in the cart.
expected_results: Product is successfully added to the cart.
Cart reflects the correct product details and quantity.
edge_cases: User adds a product that is out of stock.
Add to cart button fails to respond.
Cart page fails to load correctly.
User attempts to add multiple quantities of the same product.
Cart does not reflect the added product.
data_requirements: Frontend logic for displaying cart items.
dependencies: Product must exist in the Accessories category.
Add to cart functionality must be implemented.
api_interactions: API call to add product to cart.
API call to fetch cart details.
performance_metrics: Response time for adding product to cart.
accessibility_requirements: Add to cart button must have ARIA roles.
Cart page must be navigable via keyboard.
Screen readers must correctly read cart details.
